row: Restore Therapy Scar Training and Scar Clinic

Emma Holly at Restore Therapy is the leading educator in Britain on the subject of scars for manual therapists and over 2,000 therapists have enrolled onto the Restore Therapy courses. She teaches scar therapy courses online and in-person and lectures internationally. Therapist training courses are available around the UK, Australia and New Zealand and online.  Private clinic appointments with Emma in London’s most prestigious medical address, Harley Street.

Scar therapy is used to improve feeling and functionality in the scar and surrounding tissues, creating better movement between the layers of the skin, fascia (connective tissue) and muscle. Using non-invasive methods to help mature or new scars and complications associated with surgery and trauma such as fibrosis and adhesions.  See www.restoretherapy.co.uk for training details and www.restoretherapyclinic.co.uk to book a private scar therapy treatment with Emma in Harley Street.
